full_judgment: 17. We find that P.W. 17 and 19 husband and wife respectively are interested witnesses and they are enimical to accused Jamai Faraque and others as we find from the evidence of P.W. 17 that the accused person caused fracture of his both hands and feet and he became disabled. So their evidence cannot be relied upon. Since the evidence of P.Ws. 17 and 19 do not inspire confidence, the some cannot be accepted as corroborative evidence of the approver witness P.W. 20). As EWs. 17 and 19 gave contradictory evidence regarding place and manner of occurrence, the natural presumption is they did not see the occurrence.
